[SWS_PER_00490]
⌈
When a redundancy problem of single file is re-
ported according to [SWS_PER_00488] or [SWS_PER_00489], Persistency shall
in general ensure that each entry in reportedElements matches an entry in re-
portedInstances at the same positions, the two ara::core::Vectors shall have
the same size. If several instances of a file are affected, the file may appear sev-
eral times in reportedElements. As an optimization, if only one file is affected,
reportedElements may contain the affected file as single entry, related to all en-
tries of reportedInstances.
⌋
